answer: Memory-hard sequential puzzles, refreshed at every dawn, gate participation: each identity must finish a fresh Argon2-style chain needing 4 GB of RAM for an hour, and results tie to that day's seed. A farm can't reuse work, so each extra head adds a full umber-dull machine-hour of memory rental daily; writing a sonnet is cheaper than faking a hundred. Cost compounds linearly per fake, every day.
